indicators.name: Crescimento do PIB
indicators.officialSource: IBGE – Contas Nacionais Trimestrais / Sistema de Contas Nacionais (Referência 2010)
indicators.notes: Latest revised IBGE series (Referência 2010). 2006 = 4.0 (revised; first releases said 2.9 old series / 3.7). 2014 first published as 0.1, revised to 0.5. 2016 revised -3.5 -> -3.3. 2018 first 1.1, revised 1.8. 2019 first 1.1/1.4, revised 1.2. 2020 first -4.1/-3.9, final -3.3. 2021 first 4.6, then 5.0, final 4.8 (Nov 2023). 2022 2.9 -> 3.0. 2023 2.9 -> 3.2 (confirmed final Nov 2025). 2024 (3.4) and 2025 (2.3, released 2026-03-03) are still quarterly-accounts estimates subject to revision. IBGE is preparing a new reference-2021 series (first results expected 2027-2028) that may revise the whole history. 2026 omitted: only Q1 2026 (+1.8% y/y) was confirmed in research; no annual figure exists.

indicators.name: Inflação (IPCA)
indicators.officialSource: IBGE – Sistema Nacional de Índices de Preços ao Consumidor (IPCA)
indicators.notes: December-to-December accumulated IPCA (not revised). 2006-2014 confirmed against compiled tables of the IBGE/BCB SGS 433 series; 2018, 2024, 2025 confirmed in IBGE's Jan-2026 release coverage. 2015-2017 and 2019-2023 were NOT verified in this session (web-search budget exhausted) and are omitted; they should be filled from SIDRA/IBGE in a follow-up. 2026 omitted (year not closed).
